m: The {Robot} clanks up the {Staircase} of the {Jungle}, where a *standing person* has been waiting for a hundred years with a pink *ribbon* tied round her nose. Monkeys tug it, parrots peck it, a hurricane blows through, and the *ribbon* is **still** there. The Robot checks again next century: she is **still** standing, **still** beribboned, and **still** annoyed.

The {Ninja} somersaults down the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and lands in a ballroom packed with bearded *man* after bearded *man*. Every guest is **male**: the cook, the maid, the baby in the pram, even the cat has a moustache. A sign on the door reads **male** guests only, and the Ninja sticks on a fake beard to blend in.

The {Cheerleader} high-kicks up the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} waving *twin blades* instead of pom-poms. Every kick slices a bar of metal into shiny *gold coins* that rain down the steps. The clerks scramble on their knees stuffing **money** into their socks, and the Cheerleader chants: give me an M, give me **money**!

The {Pirate} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Fort} riding a giant *stone* like a sledge. He lands right on the army drum, and its stretched *hide* splits with a boom. Now the drum is **broken**, the floor is **broken**, the Pirate's wooden leg is **broken**, and the general's afternoon nap is very much over.

The {Wizard} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and waves his wand at an old stone *archway*. Silver cords shoot out and knot themselves into a huge *lattice*, a fishing **net** stretched across the arch. A runaway jet plane rolls straight into it and bounces back, wriggling like a trout in the **net**.

The {Robot} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and lands, wrists locked in *handcuffs*, on a bed of glowing *embers*. The cuffs turn red, its metal bottom starts to sizzle, and steam pours from its ears. It's **hot**, so **hot** that the Robot cooks a fried egg on its own head while it waits for the key.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and is about to sink, horse and all. A *strong arm* bursts out of the water and props a *stepladder* against the side. The Jockey climbs out, then the horse climbs out, then a soggy duck. Everybody shouts thanks to the arm, which waves back, happy **to help**, always ready **to help**.

The {Dentist} pops out of the {Trapdoor} at the top of the {Tower} feet first. A *standing person* waiting at the *arrival* gate grabs his ankles and holds him **upside down**, so all his drills and mirrors clatter out of his pockets. Soon the whole tower flips **upside down** too, and the visitors have to walk on the ceiling.

The {Yogi} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} clutching a tiny baby *moon* in a nappy. He feeds it moonbeams from a bottle, sings it lullabies and measures it on the wall each night. Slowly he helps **to raise** it until it is a full moon, so heavy he needs a crane **to raise** it up into the sky.

The {Sheriff} wades into the {Basement} of the {Pool} where all his *kinfolk* are splashing about. Every one of them wears a rubber ring stamped with his family name. A lost inflatable flamingo floats by and he stamps it too: now it seems **to belong to** the clan. By sunset even the pool seems **to belong to** them.

The {Zookeeper} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} onto a crate where a *sitting pair* of gorillas are lounging. There is no room left, so he has **to sit** on their laps. A forklift beeps by and its driver also tries **to sit** down, and soon fourteen people are stacked on one crate, all perfectly comfortable.

The {Dentist} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and finds a *sky god* sunbathing on a golden deckchair. The god wears a crown and a robe of clouds: he is the **emperor** of everything. He opens wide for a check-up and the Dentist finds every tooth is a tiny palace, because even the **emperor**'s teeth need somewhere grand to live.

The {Shepherd} herds sheep through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and up a steep *hillside* of banknotes. At the top an owl fixes him with a terrible *glare*: no further, this is the edge. Every time a sheep crosses the line the *glare* zaps its wool off. The owl's job is **to limit** spending, and also **to limit** sheep.

The {Chef} sails down the {Staircase} of the {Swan Pond} in a *boat* made from a giant soup pot, stirring with an oar. The swans hop aboard demanding dinner, the **boat** tips, and spaghetti spills into the pond. The Chef just keeps rowing and calls it a cruise **boat**, buffet included.

The {Lifeguard} dives into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} where an *assembly* of bankers stares up at a glowing *moon*. Its round pale **face** opens its eyes and winks. Every banker gasps, their mouths drop, and suddenly every **face** in the room turns the same silver colour, like a coin.

The {Jockey} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Beehive}, where a *lone bird* sits with one enormous *ear* pressed to the honeycomb. Its **duty** is to listen for the queen's orders and pass them on. The Jockey offers it a holiday, but the bird refuses with a salute: **duty** first, and anyway the bees bring snacks.

The {Sailor} shoots out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and lands on a slippery *road*. Someone has tied a *bundle* of rockets to his back and he zooms off, **fast**, faster, waterskiing on the tarmac. Cars spin in his wake, and a snail at the roadside holds up a sign: too **fast**!

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and comes face to face with a *wild boar* holding a *standing knife* like a clock hand. The boar carves a notch in the wall every **moment**, tick, tick, tick. The King stays perfectly still, because if he blinks he'll miss the exact **moment** the boar notices him.

The {Lifeguard} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and lands in a nest of *joy bells*. They ring, jingle, clang, and everyone within a mile starts dancing. The grumpy farmer next door is suddenly **happy**, his cows are **happy**, and the Lifeguard swims laps across the floor out of pure delight.

The {Firefighter} storms into the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} and asks the boats if they started the fire. A huge *mouth* on the wall opens and spits out a red *no sign*. Every boat holds one up. They all want **to deny** it, they **deny** everything, while smoke curls from the canoe's pocket.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} slicing the roof *ridge* with a *standing knife* to plant tulips in the crack. A plane lands right where the ridge **just** was. The Gardener shrugs, it's **just** a flower bed, then plants a tulip on the plane's nose.

The {Wizard} hovers over the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house, but a *woman* is already up there swinging an enormous *battle axe*. With one swing she splits the lake in two and the fish line up to salute. The Wizard drops his wand: her **power** beats his magic. Thunder rumbles, impressed by her **power**.

The {Magician} glides down the {Staircase} of the {Tower} and pulls a ball of *fur* out of his top hat. It keeps coming: metres of **hair**, then kilometres, a river of **hair** pouring down every step. At the bottom a bald man gratefully sticks a handful on his head.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swamp} onto a *split log* where a *dog* is chewing a branch. The dog carves the log into any **shape** you shout: a horse, a teapot, a crocodile. The crocodile carving comes to life and swims off, and the Jockey asks for something in the **shape** of a boat.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and casts a *dragnet* across the dinosaur hall. She counts what she catches every minute: three mummies an hour, five fossils a minute. A scoreboard flashes the catch **rate**, and the curator complains her **rate** of stealing is too high.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} into an *overflowing bowl* of candyfloss that keeps on swelling. It covers the rides, the ticket booth, **even** the Ferris wheel. Then it covers the Sheriff, **even** his hat, **even** the tip of his moustache, until only his badge sticks out.

The {Dentist} wanders up the {Staircase} of the {Pool} where a *prowling dog* guards a single tiny *bug* floating on a lilo. Everyone else has fled the water. The bug sunbathes **alone** in the whole pool, sipping a cocktail, and the Dentist decides to leave it **alone** too.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels up the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel}, where a *king* in a *fur coat* is rolled up into a perfect **ball**. She kicks him down the hall like a football, the hostel backpackers pass him around, and his crown pings off. He bounces happily, he's always wanted to be a **ball**.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} selling loaves to a *boatman* who rows by in the gutter. He wants every **kind**: rye, sourdough, rolls, buns, croissants. The Baker throws him one of each **kind**, and the boat sinks under the weight of the bread.

The {Pirate} kicks open the {Basement} of the {Pool} and floods it with *broad daylight* from his lantern. Suddenly everything is visible to everyone: the lost goggles, the socks, the shark. This is a **general** announcement, he roars, as the light spreads to every corner, the **general** public cheers.

The {Pirate} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and lands in the mud bath, face to face with a *white dove*. His *standing heart* thumps so hard it rises out of his chest. He's always been terrified of birds. He has a hook and a sword, yet he dares not move, so great is his **fear**. Pirates aren't supposed **to fear** anything.

The {Dentist} blasts out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} with a *bow* in one hand and a tennis *racket* in the other. He fires a **bullet** with the bow, then smacks it back with the racket, ping, pong, through every chandelier. The butler catches the last **bullet** on a silver tray.

The {Shepherd} crawls out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café} and finds a class in session under a *tree* growing through the floor. The cats sit with *crossed legs* on cushions, chalk on their whiskers, learning their sums. It's a **school**, and the Shepherd is the oldest pupil at the **school**.

The {King} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and drinks tea from an *antique* cup filled with pond *grass*. His face crumples, his crown spins: it is so **bitter**! He spits it into the pool, which turns green and **bitter** too, and the frogs complain.

The {Chef} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swamp} into a *barn* full of junk. He grabs a *standing knife* and carves, glues and hammers until he has made a robot alligator that cooks soup. He loves **to create** things nobody has ever seen, and tomorrow he plans **to create** a soup that cooks alligators.

The {Juggler} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Piazza}, where a *standing person* is handing out a *borrowed tool*: a plastic hammer. Everything here is **fake**: the gold is chocolate, the statues are cardboard, the pigeons run on batteries. Even the Juggler's balls turn out to be **fake**, they're painted grapes.

The {Juggler} curls up in the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} under a *blanket* and falls asleep for a **long** time. The cleaner comes every year to *sweep* round him, then decades pass and a beard grows over the floor. He wakes up, yawns, and asks how **long** he slept.

The {Tsar} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and starts paying the workers in *sun-dried meat* and bacon. Then he feeds the dogs *gold coins*. Everything is **wrong**, totally **wrong**: the workers chew the coins and the dogs buy a sofa.

The {Chef} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} with *three planks* balanced on his head. Two *lifting hands* reach out of the ferns to help him **bear** the weight, but then they pile on a gorilla, a hippo and a wedding cake. He has **to bear** it all the way to the top.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Inn} and lands on a *kneeling man* who has been dipped in ink. Every time the man bows, he stamps himself on the floor. The Yogi uses him **to print** posters of himself all over the walls, until even the guests have a little **print** on their foreheads.

The {Wizard} hides in the {Basement} of the {Mansion} while a sly *dodger* sneaks off with the *sun* in a sack. Without it, it's suddenly **evening**: the lamps flicker on, the bats wake up. The Wizard chases the dodger round the boiler room, but it stays **evening** forever.

The {Lifeguard} slides down the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} into a jungle of *orchids*. Each **orchid** sniffs, coughs and demands a glass of water. She rushes around with her whistle, saving drowning flowers in the vase, and finally pins the prettiest **orchid** to her red swimsuit.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and holds a *stencil* of a bee. A *small speech bubble* pops out: wanna buzz? He paints himself yellow and black **to try** flying, flapping his arms. The bees giggle, but he'll **try** again tomorrow.

The {Gardener} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and smashes a *war club* on a slice of the *moon*. It shatters into a hundred little pieces, each a **stock** certificate, a share of the moon. Bankers dive into the pool to grab them, shouting: buy **stock** now, sell later!

The {Ninja} sprints up the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and a giant *hand* bursts from a jar under a *fitted lid*. It grabs his sword, the towels and a bucket of mud. The hand will not let go: it loves **to hold** things, and wants **to hold** the Ninja next.

The {Ninja} slips into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and finds a glowing *moon* sitting in a jar with wires sticking out. It's a giant **brain**, thinking out loud, solving puzzles and writing poems. The Ninja tries to steal it, but the **brain** guesses his plan and locks the door first.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} with an *offering* of fruit and a *page* from tomorrow's newspaper. He knows everything **in advance**: the vase will fall at noon, the guard will sneeze at one. He puts cushions under the vase **in advance**, and hands the guard a tissue.

The {Sheriff} stomps up the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house, where a *sparrow* is shouting a *small speech bubble* at every passer-by: **who**? **Who** are you? **Who** stole my worm? The Sheriff shows his badge, the sparrow points a wing at the duck.

The {Yogi} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} carrying a *spilling dish* of vitamins. Everything they splash on gets better: a starfish grows an extra arm, a sandcastle turns into a real castle. It is all **benefit**, pure **benefit**, and the seagulls line up for a sip.

The {Yogi} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar}, to the top of a *hillside* where a *sun* is stuck in the mud. He heaves and pulls until the **sun** pops out like a cork and rises. Planes take off wearing sunglasses, the **sun** shines into every hangar.

The {Robot} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and meets its *lookalike*: another robot, exactly the same, except it's made of cardboard. It **seems** real, it **seems** to beep, it **seems** to think, and nobody can tell them apart. The boss gives the cardboard one the promotion.

The {Ninja} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Spa} where a huge *mouth* floats over three identical hot tubs. A *pointing finger* swings between them like a compass: **which** one? This one? That one? The Ninja jumps into the wrong tub, it fizzes like lemonade, and the mouth keeps asking **which**, **which**, **which**.

The {Wizard} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house and follows a trail of *footsteps* no bigger than rice grains. They lead to a **tiny** army of ants carrying a **tiny** cake. He shrinks himself to join the party and gets lost inside a crumb.

The {Ninja} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} and bumps into a *nun* surfing down the steps on an ironing board. The **nun** does a backflip, lands in a sandcastle and starts praying for bigger waves. The Ninja bows: this **nun** is stealthier than any ninja.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} spinning a *silk thread* that never ends. He knits a scarf, then a jumper, then a blanket for the whole beach, and he can't stop. Night falls and he has **to continue**, the crabs bring him tea so he can **continue** till dawn.

The {Sailor} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} with a pizza box and races along a winding *road* over a snowy *mountain pass*. Wolves chase him, avalanches tumble, but he must **deliver** it hot. He knocks on the door of an igloo **to deliver** it, and the penguin inside refuses to tip.

The {Juggler} scrambles up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} with a *racing heart* banging out of his chest like a drum. The tide is coming, his juggling balls are rolling into the sea, the ice cream van is leaving: it's all **urgent**! He sprints in circles yelling **urgent**, **urgent**, and drops everything.

The {Shepherd} skates through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} carrying a *dish* and a single red *drop*. It's a vampire's dinner: one *drop* of **blood** on a fancy plate. The vampire on skates sips it with a straw, says it needs salt, and the Shepherd blushes **blood**-red.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} when a whole *palace* pops up out of nowhere in the ring below. His *standing heart* leaps so high it bonks him on the chin. Fireworks bang, he drops his clubs, and the boxers are **startled** too: nothing can **startle** a crowd like a surprise palace.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} as a *standing person* topples off a plane wing and lands on him. Ouch, an **injury**! Now both have bandaged ankles, bruised elbows and a broken pride. The ambulance arrives, sees one more **injury** on the roof, and calls for a second ambulance.

The {Sailor} sinks through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and finds a *seedling top* sprouting from a ball of white *silk skein*. Nothing else: no colours, no pattern, no flavour. The whole pool is **plain**, the water, the tiles, even his sandwich is **plain** bread.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a garden of magic *grass* tied in a *promise knot*. He boils the knot into green soup, swallows it and his sneeze vanishes. It's **medicine**, and the knights queue up for a spoonful of **medicine**.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} onto a *road* made of a giant sticky *tongue*. Every shoe that steps on it gets licked into the right size. His old boots finally **fit**, his hat **fits**, and even the bees' tiny shoes now **fit**.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} throwing dough into the sea, and a huge *wave* comes back made of custard. The **wave** sweeps the soldiers off the wall and into the moat, and the next **wave** brings sprinkles.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and the lights go out: it is pitch black *night*. Owls hoot, the moon peeks through the chimney, he lights a candle and meditates all **night**. In the morning the hut is still dark, because the **night** liked it there.

The {Sheriff} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Jungle} with one beady *eye* on every penny. He takes a tiny *pinch* of rice for dinner, a pinch of water, a pinch of light. He wants **to save** everything, and he does **save** so much that the jungle gives him a medal.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} with a *knife* and a brand-new *shirt*. Before any cooking, before any swimming, **at first**, he cuts out a pattern. Everyone asks why. **At first** you sew the apron, he says, and then you can fry the pool.

The {Shepherd} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Beach} and starts banging on a *joy drum*. The sheep start to dance, the crabs clap, the shells hum: they all **like** it. The Shepherd decides he must **like** drumming too, and plays all night.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and stands a *plank* upright in front of the door. He casts a spell and the plank comes alive, salutes, and begins **to guard** the house with a little wooden sword. Ducks try to sneak in, but the **guard** sends them off.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mint}, following *water drops* upward. At the top a *cliff spring* gushes coins instead of water. That's the **source** of all money, he realises, and the bankers fill their buckets at the **source**.

The {Sheriff} marches up the {Staircase} of the {Beehive} and finds *food* everywhere: honey pies, pollen pizzas, waxy sandwiches. The bees have built a restaurant. He eats so much **food** that he gets stuck in the door, and the bees bring more **food** to cheer him up.

The {Shepherd} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, down a slippery *hillside* of coins. At the bottom an *assembly* of snarling wolves in suits waits. **Danger**! He tiptoes, holding his breath, every step a **danger**, until the sheep pull him back with a rope.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} into a *temple* where a line of *footsteps* stops at a bench. He has **to wait**, and he waits for a year, two, a decade, until a palm tree grows from his head. A sign reads: please **wait**, the dentist will see you soon.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} onto a *road* where a performer is doing a *magic trick*. The magician won't stop talking: he loves **to tell** how the trick works, every single detail. The Sheriff begs him to stop, but he has more **to tell**.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and swims for hours until she reaches a *hillside*. She gives the sand a *punch*: it is solid! **Land**! She plants a flag and declares the pool's bottom a new **land**, and the ducks apply for citizenship.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} flapping a *single wing* he found in the sand. He flaps, falls, flaps, falls, for hours, every day. He must **practise**, the seagulls laugh, but he goes on **to practise** until he hovers one inch in the air.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} holding a *fishing net* and a *plumb line*. Using the line he works out exactly where **to place** each honeycomb, then he scoops them up with the net and **places** them straight, in perfect rows.

The {Juggler} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Museum} and builds a tiny *house* out of his juggling clubs. It is his new **residence**, with a doorbell made of a juggling ball. The curator writes it down as the museum's smallest **residence**, and charges him rent.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower}, where a sweaty *labourer* is carrying the building up stone by stone. He does not stop **to toil**, he toils all day and all night. The Lifeguard brings him a lemonade, and even that he carries **to toil**.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Island} and finds a *shell* with a *green shoot* growing out. Every leaf on the shoot is a banknote! He waters it with champagne and soon the whole island is covered in **wealth**, and he's the richest man in the sea, with **wealth** sprouting from his ears.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Swan Pond} and finds a *king* holding a *no sign*. The king pulls off his crown and flings it onto the pond, where it turns into a golden **ring** floating on the water. Swans swim through the **ring** like circus lions.

The {Pirate} marches up the {Staircase} of the {Island} and a *helping hand* shoves all the parrots into a row, their *spread wings* touching. The Pirate barks orders and everyone must **line up**: crabs, coconuts, even the treasure chests **line up** neatly.

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} and finds a *small altar* with a *full jar* of golden coins. She bows to it, and luck rains down: she finds keys, socks, a winning ticket. It's **good fortune**, and the pool turns into a fountain of **good fortune**.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} into an *inner room* tied up with *silk thread*. Guests hand him their gifts, and he must **accept** every one: a teapot, a towel, a wet frog. He nods politely to **accept** each one until the room is full.

The {Hunter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} and lifts his *right hand* as the swans give an enormous *yawn* that turns into a laugh. The whole pond is **joyous**, swans dancing, frogs singing. The Hunter puts down his bow and joins in, **joyous** as a child.

The {Lifeguard} sprints up the {Staircase} of the {Lake} house as *rain* pours onto the *rice field* behind it. **Thunder** booms so loud the rice jumps out of the mud, and the Lifeguard blows her whistle at the clouds. The **thunder** answers with a burp.

The {Juggler} hides in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} until a *speech bubble* bursts through the ceiling: STOP! A crisp *salute* follows. The **police** have arrived, an officer in each corner of the ring, and they arrest the Juggler for juggling **police** hats.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} into *grass* where two dogs are having a *dog fight* over a bone. He reaches in, grabs it, and wins: he manages **to obtain** the bone! Both dogs turn and chase him, so now he will have **to obtain** a bigger bone.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort}, where a *tree* glows against a dramatic *sunset*. He snaps his fingers and the tree poses, chin up, like a fashion **model**. The soldiers paint it, sculpt it and build a tiny **model** of it in clay.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} hut pumping air into a *balloon*. He wants **to fill** it with soup, then air, then more soup. It swells, bigger and bigger, filling the sky, until the lagoon floats away. He begs it **to fill** no more.

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} wearing a huge *backpack* stuffed with hoses, fire engines and three grandmothers. She must **bear** it all, and she does, swimming laps with it. Nobody else can **bear** such a load.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Dunes} and sits on a fluffy *cloud* parked there like a taxi. The **cloud** lifts off, raining on the hot sand and growing cacti on its way. He waves down to the camels from his **cloud**.

The {Tailor} races up the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} where a *standing person* is sheltering under a *pavilion*. He's shouting **stop**! at the boxers, who all freeze mid-punch. The Tailor measures them while they **stop**, and sews them matching shorts.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and pulls a *tree* out of his hat. Then another **tree**, and another, until the pool is a forest and the swimmers are in the branches. The lifeguard asks for one more **tree** to hang his whistle on.

The {Yogi} floats up the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} on a stream of *water drops*, waving a long *streamer* like a tour guide. He wants **to tour** every boat, and the tourists follow his streamer from canoe to yacht. Next he plans **to tour** the duck pond.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} hut and finds a *dragon* doing laps in the water. The **dragon** breathes fire and boils the lagoon into a hot tub. The Lifeguard blows her whistle, so the **dragon** puts on armbands and swims slower.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and finds a *tree* waltzing with its *dance partners*, two other trees. They twirl their branches, drop their leaves, and splash. He arrests the most reckless **tree** for dancing in a pool, but the **tree** just keeps dancing in jail.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Beach} making a *puzzled face* at the sea. Is it real? Is the sand real? Is he real? He starts **to doubt** everything, then he begins **to doubt** his doubts, and the crabs give up waiting for an answer.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} and finds a *lying man* sleeping on a *cloud*. On top of him sleeps another man on a cloud, and another: **layer** after **layer** of sleepers stacked up to the treetops like a cake.

The {Lifeguard} dives into the {Basement} of the {Jungle} where *icicles* hang from the vines. A shivering *herald* blows a trumpet and announces: it's **cold**! So **cold** that the monkeys wear scarves and the parrots freeze mid-squawk. The herald's trumpet note itself freezes and drops to the floor with a clink.

The {Jockey} gallops across the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} while *water drops* fall onto a map and form *islands*. They join up, grow and spread, until a whole **continent** appears and his horse can gallop from one coast to the other of a new **continent**.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} hut, slides down a chute of *icicles* and aims at a *bullseye* painted on the water. He has **to rush**, faster and faster, ladle first, and hits it dead centre with a mighty splash. The fish **rush** off to tell their friends.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut}, where an *archer* is aiming at his hat. The archer lets go and the arrow zips past, so the Sheriff draws his pistol **to shoot** back. They **shoot** at each other all afternoon, but only ever hit the teapot.

The {Lifeguard} skates through the {Trapdoor} of the {Ice Rink} and finds a *visitor* drawing a map of a *rice field* on the ice. He only scratches the **outline**: four lines, no details, no rice. The Lifeguard adds a duck, and the visitor yells that it's just an **outline**!

The {Firefighter} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} as a *flood* pours in and lays *grass* in a perfect pattern across the ballroom. Everyone gasps: it's the **model** of a perfect garden. The Firefighter sprays her hose to copy it, and now every guest wants a **model** lawn.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring} right during the *finale*. Everyone thinks the champion will win, but **unexpectedly** the Juggler knocks him out with a juggling ball. The crowd gasps, and **unexpectedly** the referee gives the belt to a pigeon.

The {Juggler} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and catches a *quotation* flying out of an old book. Each word is a ball, and he juggles them into a **sentence**: the cat sat on the king. The king, in a nearby portrait, objects to the **sentence**.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and sees an *arrow landing* under a *roof* of wax. Where it lands, a **room** appears with walls, a bed and a little lamp. The bees fire more arrows, building a **room** for every guest.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} and finds a *cobra* sitting in the *grass* wearing a tutu. Everything here is **different**: the sea is purple, the sand tastes of mint, the crabs walk forwards. The Yogi meditates upside down, just to be **different** too.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut juggling *water drops* that throw off a *sparkle* each time they fall. The sparkles **arouse** the sleepy seagulls, who start dancing. Each drop is sure **to arouse** more excitement, until the whole beach is awake and cheering.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and splashes into *water drops* pouring from a *right hand* painted on the ceiling. They spell out the river name **Han** in shiny letters. He writes **Han** on his hat and rows down the hallway.

The {Tsar} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Casino} and balances a whole *tree* on his *thumb*. A tiny **village** sprouts in its branches: huts, a well, a market, chickens clucking. The gamblers stop playing cards and bet on which **village** chicken will lay the first egg, and the Tsar wobbles to keep everyone from falling out.

The {Hunter} climbs on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} and lifts the *fitted lid* off a hot tub. A giant *mouth* inside lets out a booming laugh: **ha**! **Ha**! The bubbles laugh too, the towels giggle, and the Hunter falls off the roof laughing.

The {Tsar} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and lays out a battle **plan** using *bamboo* sticks and a sharp *thorn* as pointer. Sticks are soldiers, the thorn is the general. The mouse at his feet suggests a better **plan**.

The {Yogi} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and finds a stage lit by a *temple arrow* and dripping *water drops*. He must **perform** a play, so he bends into a pretzel, sings opera and juggles cucumbers. The rats throw roses: they love **to perform** too.

The {Juggler} climbs into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} where the bankers are lost in complicated spreadsheets. He strings a *bamboo* curtain across a *gap* in the wall and draws one line on it: buy cheap, sell dear. It's **simple**, so **simple** that the bankers cry and frame it.

The {King} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Spa}, where a *fortune stick* points *upstairs*. He climbs and finds a **card** stuck between the floors: his own credit **card**, wedged there for years. He prises it out and buys a mud bath.

The {Zookeeper} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and finds a parrot with *spread wings* caught in a *fishing net*. The parrot has stolen all the magazines, a terrible **crime**! The Zookeeper reads out the list of each **crime**, and the parrot pleads innocent in three languages.

The {Pirate} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and sees two lords fighting over a cake. He draws a *standing knife* and cuts it exactly in *half*. Both are pleased. Everyone asks him **to judge** every quarrel in the house, and he must **judge** fairly or walk the plank.

The {Dentist} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} while a *helping hand* lifts a glowing *sunrise* onto his shoulders. He must **carry** it across the roof without dropping it. It's heavy and hot, but he manages **to carry** it all the way to the chimney, and morning begins.

The {Jockey} gallops along the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse}, jumping from one of the *islands* to the next in a river. Each one is a **state** with a flag and a mayor. The Jockey is crowned governor of every **state** and gives his horse a seat in parliament.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boxing Ring} into a soft bed of *moss*, where two boxers are frozen in a *tug of war*. Nobody moves. Everything is **calm**, perfectly still, not a whisper. The Juggler drops a ball and the crowd glares, so **calm** is the room.

The {Tailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room}, sees a queue of four hundred grumpy people, and makes an instant *u-turn*. He must **retreat**, walking backwards with needles blazing. One by one everyone in the room begins **to retreat** too, shuffling backwards out of the door, until the receptionist sits alone with the magazines.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} with a hamper, but all he finds is a *finished meal*: empty plates, chicken bones, one sad crumb. The seagulls have **already** eaten everything, sandwiches, cake and the napkins. He's **already** too late, and the fattest gull burps politely and asks what's for pudding.

The {Yogi} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut wearing a giant *robe*. He pulls out more **clothes**: a scarf, socks, a ball gown. He dresses the seagulls, the crabs and the sun, and soon the beach is full of **clothes**.

The {Ninja} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Inn}, bowing to every guest with his *heart* in his hand. To each *you* he says a polite **you**: after **you**, sir; thank you, madam. Even the mice get bows, and they bow back.

The {Zookeeper} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} hut and finds an *ancestral hall* full of monkeys in robes chanting. They are a **sect** that worships bananas. The Zookeeper joins the **sect** and soon chants with a banana on his head.

The {Juggler} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut as a *lone bird* drops one *grain stalk* after another onto his head. He doesn't move. Year after year the grain starts **to accumulate**, into a haystack, then a mountain. He wears a hat of **accumulated** grain.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Museum} carrying a tray of *leftovers* from the great feast. There is too much: **surplus** pies, spare sausages, extra cake. He hands the **surplus** to the statues, who are delighted to eat for the first time in centuries.

The {Tailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} hut onto a *sickbed* inside a dark *tunnel*. Ow, ow, ow! He's sat on his own pins. The **pain** shoots up, and he rolls over onto more pins. **Pain**, pain, pain, until the doctor arrives with tweezers.

The {Juggler} hides in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} as an *assembly* of inspectors marches in, each holding a magnifying glass. They climb every *tree* of coins **to check** each one for fakes. They **check** the Juggler's balls too, and find a fake grape.

The {Chef} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} and finds a *sheep* at a *workbench*, trying to bake a cake. It's **short of** sugar, **short of** eggs, short of time. The Chef gives it his last egg, and now he's **short of** dinner.

The {Firefighter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} into a house where the *roof* shelters a *full jar* of gold. She sprays it with water and it overflows, gold everywhere! Now she's **rich**, so **rich** that she buys a golden fire engine.

The {Lifeguard} bounds up the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} with a *comb* that she runs through the flames of a *campfire*. The fire turns **quick** and nimble, darting and dancing like a boxer. The Lifeguard herself becomes **quick**, dodging punches with a wink.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} and finds a *cross* carved on the door of a *workshop*. Inside, yetis must **cooperate**: one saws, one hammers, one paints. They **cooperate** so well they build a sleigh in five minutes.

The {Juggler} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} and finds an *ox horn* poking out of every **corner**. The cats each sit in a **corner**, fighting over the horns. The Juggler juggles them, and the cats sulk in their corners.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and a *fortune teller* is sitting in every chair, every bath, every bed. She moved in uninvited and plans **to occupy** the whole house. She even manages **to occupy** the Jockey's saddle.

The {Pirate} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house with a *wine jug* and a *coiled rope*. He tries **to match** them: jug and rope, cup and saucer, boot and sock, shark and teeth. Everything finds its partner, and he's left without a **match**.

The {Jockey} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple and blows a horn to start a *march*. Monkeys, tigers and parrots come running. He wants **to recruit** them all for his army, and they **recruit** each other in a long parade.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Hostel} with a hammer, a needle and a roll of tape. Everything is broken: the chimney, the satellite dish, the backpackers' socks. He sets out **to repair** them all, sewing, nailing, taping, until he must **repair** the hammer too.

The {Pirate} hops up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} with a crocodile *hide* slung over his shoulder. He unzips it and steps in, wearing the **skin** like a onesie. The crocodile pops out of the sea and demands its **skin** back.

The {Hunter} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room}, and a *helping hand* gives him a flag to signal an *army* below. He starts **to wave**, and the soldiers march left, then right. He **waves** too fast, and the army ends up dancing the conga.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} under a full *moon* and sees a *seedling* racing a tree. The **victory** goes to the seedling, which grows a mile in a night! The Sheriff pins a medal on it for its **victory**.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Stadium} and slides down a *hillside* of seats, *descending feet* first. He begins **to fall**, faster and faster, juggling as he goes. The crowd watches him **fall** onto the pitch and score a goal.

The {Juggler} wobbles on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave} while a *go-between* runs up and down the snowy *hillside* carrying love letters. To save his legs, the yeti carves **stairs** into the slope, step after step, then a thousand more. Soon the **stairs** reach the clouds and the go-between takes a lift instead.

The {Sheriff} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, where a *courtroom* has been built inside the ghost train. He must **examine** each witness: a clown, a candyfloss, a carousel horse. He **examines** them one by one with a magnifying glass.

The {Chef} drops down the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} into a pond of *water drops*, carrying a pile of *clutter*. He begins **to sink**, pots, pans and all. The ducks watch him **sink** to the bottom, where he starts a restaurant for the fish.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} and stamps on a pile of *soil*. It's **solid**: harder than steel, harder than diamonds. He juggles bricks on it and they bounce off. Even the pigeons can't peck the **solid** floor.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion}, and a huge *mouth* on the wall says only nice things to him. It's so **kind** that it compliments his boots, offers him tea, and sings him a lullaby. The Sheriff hands out hugs, being **kind** too.

The {Magician} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} and pulls a *woman* riding a *horse* out of his hat. It's his **mom**, who gallops around the roof telling him to put on a coat. He tries to make his **mom** disappear, but she just takes the hat away.
